card.name: Digits inside radiation dose tables
card.fires_on: Digits (or the y of microGy) in the middle of numbers in radiopharmaceutical dosimetry tables and dose ranges with mCi, MBq, mGy. It also fires on a few other digits inside numbers in labels.

modes.label: Dosimetry table numbers
modes.description: A middle digit in a number such as mGy/MBq conversion values in absorbed-dose tables.
modes.example: Organ rads/30 mCi mGy/1<<1>>10 MBq rads/3

modes.label: Dose range in MBq
modes.description: A digit inside an activity range given in MBq and mCi.

modes.label: Unit letter in dose units
modes.description: The y of microGy right before /MBq in a table header.
modes.example: Target organ rad/mCi microG<<y>>/MBq rad/mCi microG
